Settings.TITLE: Settings
Settings.CONFIRM_BODY: Missions, experience, crystals, upgrades and records will be reset. This cannot be undone. Your settings will stay.

Info.TITLE: About the game
Info.ABOUT_BODY:
Invaders Must Die is a side-scrolling arcade shooter. In this fictional story, you control a dragon defending Ukrainian skies from invading aircraft.

Breathe fire, intercept missiles and survive enemy waves. Build your score, improve your dragon and complete the campaign.

Created by Andrii Pastushenko.
Info.CONTROLS_BODY:
Drag the left joystick to move; hold the fire button on the right. You can move and shoot at the same time with two fingers. Play in landscape orientation.

Enable auto-fire in Settings to shoot after every reload without holding the button. You can also adjust the opacity of the joystick and fire button separately.

Tap the pause icon to pause, resume, restart or leave a level. The arrow button skips the current dialogue line.
Info.MODES_BODY:
Campaign: survive waves across {levels} locations. Completing a mission unlocks the next one; completed missions can be replayed.

Survival: an endless stream of enemies. Stay alive and beat your high score. This mode does not grant campaign experience.

Fire destroys aircraft and intercepts missiles. Missiles drain health; colliding with an aircraft is fatal. A new attempt starts at full health.
Info.UPGRADES_BODY:
Destroy aircraft and missiles to score points. In the campaign, points also grant experience: each new player level gives one crystal.

Spend crystals in Upgrade to increase health, fire speed or fire size, or to reduce reload time by {percent}% per upgrade. Fire speed means projectile speed, not movement speed.

Progress, upgrades and records are saved locally on this device. Clearing the app data removes the save.
